outcome: A credential-lifetime park clears itself for every stage once the credential is refreshed and the work runs, the admission check provably uses the dispatch's own timeout, the operator is never told to retry a refusal that retry cannot clear, and the CLI's authentication failure is recognised in the form the CLI actually emits.

acceptance.text: The credential_lifetime fact clears for every responsibility once an attempt exists under the identity that stage actually journals, including an implementation dispatched as nested work under git.seal (cycle.DispatchWork), so a refused implementation, a refresh and a real nested attempt leave no crossing and no credential_lifetime entry in Status().PinnedWork. A test proves this through Status for the nested implementation case. Anchor: internal/runtime/credential_lifetime_park_test.go.

Admission uses the dispatch's own timeout: a runtime test drives dispatch preparation with a credential whose remaining lifetime is longer than the fixed margin but shorter than the timeout plus the margin, and asserts CREDENTIAL_EXPIRES_DURING_DISPATCH with no try spent. The fixture is chosen so the test fails if either admission site ignores the timeout (internal/runtime/dispatch.go's preflight registry argument, or the admission probe's deadline). Anchor: internal/runtime/credential_lifetime_park_test.go.

The needs-you guidance for a credential_lifetime entry never tells the operator to retry (retry is refused for this cause): the reason text is asserted exactly, not by containment, and docs/run.md states accurately where the entry is visible in a single-lane and a multi-lane run. Anchor: internal/cockpit/catalog_test.go and docs/run.md.

The CLI's authentication failure is recognised in the sequence the Claude CLI actually emits. In this release's run the text "Failed to authenticate: OAuth session expired and could not be refreshed" reached the journal as worker turn text before a non-zero exit; a fixture reproduces that observed sequence and the dispatch fails with the typed credential code. Recognition stays bounded to output the CLI itself produces and never decides a verdict from model prose. Anchor: internal/driver/native_credential_preflight_linux_test.go.

constraints: S3's delivered behaviour stays exactly: an already-expired credential keeps CREDENTIAL_STALE, unparseable or missing expiry fails open, the refusal spends no try, and Status keeps the approved precedence (in-flight work reads running). This slice fixes what a blind shadow verification of S3's verified candidate found and the seat reproduced; re-derive every location from the current tree.
The e2e host check runs at -parallel=8 on the host (measured twice on this suite: 21 and 23 minutes, no failures, against 43 minutes serially). Do not change e2e tests' parallelism in this slice.

Every listed check is a host check: contained implementers and verifiers consume engine-bound host evidence and never attempt nested containment or claim to have executed these commands. Each long process suite runs once per candidate in the phase order the engine defines.

This release changes no roster, model selection, budget, timeout, retry cap or fallback behaviour except where an acceptance criterion of this slice names the change exactly. The broad supporting package scope admits only this promised mechanism and its affected regression fixtures, adapters, status projections and documentation.

Known contained-workspace facts, not defects of this slice: cmd/sworn's TestTUIActionDriveSurvivesActionReturn fails in the sandbox with CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE and prints roughly 90 KB of DEBUG output; it passes on the host. Do not chase it and do not run it in the workspace. internal/runtime exceeds Go's implicit 10-minute package deadline in the sandbox; pass -timeout=20m on your own package runs. The sandbox shell is dash without `which`. Never build a binary into the workspace root: an out-of-scope file at the root makes checkpoint capture refuse with CHECKPOINT_SCOPE_VIOLATION and fences the workspace; build into a temporary directory.

Long package runs in the workspace (internal/runtime takes 7 to 10 minutes) outlive the native CLI's tool wait; do not poll the shell while one runs. Prefer targeted `go test -run` on the packages and tests you changed; the host checks run the full suites.

If a criterion's evidence belongs in a test file other than its named anchor, either add it to the anchor or declare the substitute in the submission's `anchor_substitutes` map (criterion id to file); an undeclared substitute is refused at seal time as ANCHOR_NOT_TOUCHED.

internal/protocol is the embedded protocol package. This slice needs no change to its receipt vocabulary, check outcomes, operation assets, snapshot or pinned digests (internal/protocol/assets.go, release.json, tools/protocolgolden); if a design appears to need one, report it rather than re-pinning the bundle.

Every new failure or refusal code is admitted everywhere codes are enumerated (driver adapter error allowlist and kind classification, certification mapping where relevant, runtime park causes, status projection, cockpit catalog), carries a bounded detail with no secret, credential, absolute operator path or raw provider body, and is documented in docs/run.md.
